notes.title: Introducing: Hyperspace Invaders II: DX update!
notes.content:
It's out, 3 years after the last update!
What's changed?

[list]
[*] 3 Playable characters each with their own weapons system
[*] 1080p / 60fps smooth running gameplay
[*] Updated sprites, shaders, effects and animations
[*] Higher resolution audio (320kbps instead of 128kbps) and improved audio control
[*] Added gameplay elements (behaviours, bullet patterns, ...)
[*] Reset leaderboards due to the number of gameplay changes
[/list]


*Edit*: Something I forgot to mention: for the 2nd and 3rd player characters there is a button 2 ("B" on the gamepad or "X" on the keyboard) which affects the behavior of your options (those little helpers you get when collecting yellow powerups)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10028008/422c5b78a82887984ab2a47c4a6a0b7bf539858b.png[/img]

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE: *Startup Bug* is being hunted down
notes.content:
People suffering from the startup bug: I'm terribly sorry for this inconvenient hyperspace malfunction!

[b]*TEMPORARY small workaround*[/b] --> rename the "steam_api.dll" file in your HIIIPE folder to something like "_steam_api.dll".
[i]WARNING: This will disable achievements & leaderboards but at least you can play it locally until it's fixed.[/i]

[b]* Debug data *[/b]
- Latest Steam SDK version: check
- Latest GMS version: check
- Latest steam_api.dll version: check but not working to desired effect... proceeding to further investigation. Message to Steam staff sent. Off to bug GMS devs. Suggestions welcome.

notes.title: HIII:PE update #5 - Extra level by Neurocore + Stats!
notes.content:

* Added a new level/track by infamous Polish flashcore artist, [b]NEUROCORE[/b]! -> includes a shiny new Leaderboard and associated achievement!
* Added "Statistics" on gameover: a new graphic display of how you did in the level and how far you got.

[b]New achievements[/b]
* LEVEL 11 CLEAR! 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
* SPEED BONUS tended to trigger on seemingly random moments. No more of that.
* Small things.

[b]Planned[/b]
* More level updates by awesome artists.
* Steam Controller vs GMS support investigation.

notes.title: HIII:PE update #3 - Gameplay balance & small aesthetics update
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Balancing & Fixes[/b]
	- [i]player movement speed[/i] (used to upgrade over time, now fixed from the start)
	- HFK level starts clean (no bosses).
	- Roadblocks (aka "Rainbow Road") more controlled and not showing anymore at unwanted times.
	- Certain bulletpatterns made less "impossible"
	- Smaller invader bullets now [i]always destructible[/i] with laserfire
	- RETRO mode: Missing a shot now causes invaders to bump down
	
[b]Graphical tweaks[/b]
	- player fire/laser aesthetic tweaks (lightning arc / motion blur / color tweaks)
	- GUI: new [i]energy-meter[/i] indicating laser potential
	- GUI: player life-indicators and player-bullet colors now make more sense.
	- Background FX now reserved for GFX SETTING 3.
	
* All [b]levels[/b] are now [b]UNLOCKED![/b] - in order to not deprive less successful players of the sonic peculiarities that occur in the later HIII levels.

[i]Coming really soon: Achievements (really, no joke)![/i]

notes.title: HIII:PE update #2 - L E A D E R B O A R D S ! ! !
notes.content:
* That's right! Leaderboards! (finally.) -- PRESS LEFT/RIGHT in the LEVEL SELECT SCREEN to see them!
* a new enemy formation
* extra roadblocks (aka "rainbow path") behaviours
* other small stuff I can't remember.

Big thanks to FirstManOnTheSpoon for helping me squash the Leaderboards bug. Check out his game Ragdoll Runner because it looks funny, and probably is great. http://ragdollrunner.com

The next update just *might* include:
* Steam Achievements
* a NEW level/track/artist (Let's just say things are about to get brutal.)

Keep your eyes peeled! Don't forget to blink!
Enjoy.

notes.title: HIII:PE update #1
notes.content:
The 1st patch is done and out there! Here's the list of things that updated:

* Full Controller Support
* Better controller mapping, better analogue joystick sensitivity + XBOX360 gamepad fix
* Added level/track progress interface element
* Remember last level played in level select menu
* Game Over name input optimized
* small animation tweaks
* bullet pattern difficulty optimization in later levels
* "Random crash on collision with snakes" aka the "snake bug" squashed!
* "X360 controller causes fps drop" aka "slowdown bug" squashed! (should it persist on your machine ---> try to switch your controller to another USB-port! Weird, but works!)

Big thanks to Mr Cunningham for the suggestions and Mr Epilexia for ultra-thorough bugtesting!

More to come. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Incoming message from Hyperspace!
notes.content:
HIII all, and welcome to my little hyperverse.

First off, a big thanks goes out to all the people who supported the game on here and Greenlight. Without you, there would be no game. Indeed, it would all have gotten lost in a cybernetic void, where the abyss of failure would've ceaslessly continued to stare into my trauma-filled soul. But now my Beast is out - and thus HI gets a better chance to grow, possibly even pay my rent from time to time. More significantly for you, I get to make more time to further improve it. So thanks for playing, giving feedback and support.

Gamewise, some minor bugs have surfaced, which should be handled by the [b]next update[/b] which is coming [b]ASAP[/b]!

[i]Already tackled:[/i]
* analogue joystick for X360 controller fix
* better gamepad mapping: FULL GAMEPAD SUPPORT, pause and escape buttons, more logically mapped.
* track/level progress interface element added
* game over name input optimized
* remember last played level in level select screen: check!

[i]Planned for next (or later) updates:[/i]
* Steam Leaderboards! Better start practising now! ;)
* Steam Achievements.
* more invader squad formations.
* various small bugfixes.
* more groovy stuff to be announced!

ps: I might take feature requests if they are possible without requiring too much of a re-write. I'm curious to hear and entertain your ideas if you have any.
Things like extra modes may not get done but may be kept in mind for the next HI generation.
You can contact me at janrobbe@gmail.com.

/End transmission!
